content: Id Yidnoon Ye Karub Ongmoon
Kwane, Yesu kuu parai motod aom awunoona, ok bowan yara ika yanenib, ye taun dobirimaan aom miniwen.

Karub yenambed karub id yidnoona keta ari angkeen kuu Yesu yaa kanminiwen. Kwane, Yesu kuu yi anam andi wedmendekore, id yidnoon karub yaa yedmoon, “Ne dana, eb niindem aom aromne. Eb ambarakmi kuu are nonondandoon.” andoon.
Andoone, Yuudan yi amob kedmengkandidan yena kuu wengambiribka, yikamo dakmiwen, “Karub kee God ye yumbon kandandamoon kowe, God yaningko monmaroon kii!” ande kamiwen.
Kumban Yesu kuu yi inamen yekaadkeroon kowe yedmoon, “Komandiwed yiib kuu kwamune arewa ye inamen yiib niindem aom meenimaib?
Komarewa kere yedmaniin kumbed yobdoodban keraneen, eb ambarakmi kuu are nonondandaan andi dee, no yedmeni yaro dore wene andi dee?

Kumban ne dowaken yiib kaadkerime andid, ne kuu Karub Ye Mingki okad yiri kuu aromkono Godbed kawoonkob, nembed nimakarub yi ambarakmi yaa are nonondandi kuu yimin kuu kei.” andekore, id yidnoon karub yaa yedmoon, “Eb yaro dore, eb keta kande ambiwoom wene.” andoona,
karub kuu kwane yaro dore ambiwoom wonoon.
Kwaniiwa, nimakarub korem wedmekoriwa, unimbed God yaningko kankooniwen, amborom kuu Godbed yaromkono darewoob kee karub keyaa konoon kowe.
Yesumbed Matyu Yaa Baandoon

Kwane, Yesu kuyaambed yaro dore wenene wedmoona, karub yaningko Matyu kuu tak od bi ye ambib mana aom dibeen. Kwane, Yesumbed yedmenoon, “Ne yoman mene.” andoone, Matyu yaro dore Yesu ye yoman wonoon.
Kwane, Yesu kuu Matyu yambiwoom awune dibere animan aneena, karub yemoon tak od bidaniib Yuudan yikanmo yi amowamob awinindodaniib menenib animan aniib ye yoom ye kedmengkandeendan yoom ibmo.
Kwane, Farisidan kuu wedmendekoriwa, ye kedmengkandeendan yaa kaamondiwen, “Komande yiib kedmengkandi korok kuu tak od bidan
yoom ambarakmidan yena yoom animan ibmo aniib?” andiwen.
Yesu kuu yi weng wengamberendekore yedmoon, “Kukuu kwamune, dokta kuu amunmo doriibdan yi dowadban, bob anikaddan yi dowad.

Kumban wenebenib God Ye Weng ye id komarewa dakmeen kuu meenime. Godbed yedmoon, ‘Ne dowaken kuu mimyob kowi awine, aye ningke agedmo kere konimban.’ andoon. Ne kuu kwamune mene yorokmodan amonombime andi dowad minindo, ambarakmidan yaa amonombime andi dowad manaan.” andoon.
Animan Koronde God Yaa Meenimo Kami
Kwane, Yoon ye kedmengkandeendanbed mene Yesu yaa kaamoniwen, “Komarewakob, nuwiib Farisidaniib kuu animan koronde God yaa meenimo kamimaub, kumban ma eb kedmengkandeebdan kuu kwanimokban?” andiwen.

Kwane, Yesumbed neman inandoon, “Wonong awanandameen ye karub yangkodmia ye yoom doriib kuu yuudi ameng kamimaiwoo? Dowan! Kumban aron mananuuna wonong awanandameen ye karub kuu nendaneenkob, yi domondaneen kumbed yi kuu animan koronde God yaa meenimo kamaniib.

“Kuruweng kei. Karub maa kuu ebkad barad yeweb kuu kandune ebkad kurin biringkoon ye dem yaa kowe kaaroon karen, ogoone ebkad barad nedbeene ebkad kurin kumbed dem darewoowiib arewa keroon karen. Kwani kowe, korem kwamimokban.

Ma, karub maa wain ok yeweb kandune wain ok yowo ba kadbed kurin ongmiwen aom bunoon karen, wain ok kabayingke kad biringke wain ok kuu onduknoone wain ok yowo korem arewa keroon karen. Kwani kowe, kwamimokban. Yi wain ok yeweb kuu wain ok yeman ba kadbed yeweb ongmiwen aombed bune nowaniibkob kwane okiib ok yemaniib kuu amunmo dangembaraneen.” andoon.
Yesumbed Yemoon Ongmenaboon

Yesu kuu kwane daandeena, Yuudan yi korok maa mene Yesu ye murubia arimbed dangbodin bumangkene yedmoon, “Ne mungkan kibirebmo bobneen. Kumban, no meneneb eb dingkimbed angkorondebko ika wadkeruk andid.” andoon.
Kwanandoone, Yesu yaro dore Yuudan yi korok yoom winiiwa, ye kedmengkandeendan kwangkon yiyiib dabokne winiwen.
Kuye niindem aombed wonong maa andemwuroon kuu weeb benme benmeyiib kereen kuu ye yoman yaro menenu Yesu yebkad dungkun yaa angkoroneneen,
amborom kuu yukareb yedmeen, “Yebkad yaa angkoronaniin kumbed wadkeraniin.” andeen.

Kwanuune, Yesu amonombene wonong kuu wedmende yedmendoon, “Dana, kub niindem aom aromne dobere. Kub anam andi kumbed ongmebdoona wadkereeb kii!” andoon. Kwanandoon kumbed kirodmo wonong kuu andemwuroon kuu dowan keroona wadkereen.
Kwane, Yesu kuu Yuudan yi korok yambiwoom awunene wedmoona, yurin wudmenabidan yuudi ye yook wudmiiwiib nimakarub yemoon kuweng darewoob kamiwen.
Wedmoonka, yedmoon, “Yiib korem wenebime. Wonong koyu kee bobnindo, no kwane unuk angkeen.” andoon. Kumban yimbed ye yaa ambon kameniwen.
Kwane yaro nimakarub yedmoona bunangka angkaniiwa, Yesu dawuro wenene yu dingki yaambed awine kankoonoone wadkere yeedureen.
Kuye weng kuu benwenebe darewoob kereen, okad kuu doriib aom korem kuu.
Kwane, Yesu kuyaambed yaro dore weneena, indob tut karub ayoob ye yoman menenib komkanmo miniwen, “Dewid ye Awo! Nub yaa mimyob keende!” andiwen.
Yesu kwane ambiwoom awunoona, indob tut karub ayoob ye yaa miniiwe, yembed kaamondoon, “Yiib meeniib kuu ne yimin ongmendaniin ande kwane meeniiwoo?” andoone, “Yariman, ee!” andiwen.
Kwane, Yesu kuu yi indob yaa angkorondene yedmoon, “Yiib anam andi kumbed amun kerundok.” andoone
yi indob amun keroon. Kwane, Yesumbed ye kaadkerime weng kee kamkonomo daandoon, “Karub yena yaa yiib dakmaiwa kaadkeraib.” andoon.
Kumban yi kuu wenenib, karub korem kuna kuna dakmenmo yariiwa kuye ambibkin kumaom korem kaadkeriwen.
Yi ayoob kwamune angkane winiiwa, karub awad arewayiib ibnenoon korem wengwaab nenminiwen, Yesu yaa.

Kwane, Yesumbed awad arewa kuu anburoona karub wengwaab andowe weng dakmoon. Kadaareb kuu wedmekoriwa, binangke kenangkanib dakmiwen, “Ayii! Kwamune keroon kee ma kwamune Israel ambibkin aom ma kwanoona wedmindo ii!” ande kamiwen.
Kumban Farisidanbed yedmiwen, “Kukuu awad arewa yi korok darewoob yaromkono kandekore, awad arewa kuu yenbudmeenkob yaro wenebiib.” ande kamiwen.
Yesu Ye Deme Karub Kuu Yemoonban
Yesu dewenebene taun yemooniib kambong yemooniib yi kurikuri ambiwoombed God ye weng amun dakmene kedmengkandene bob anikad maa maa ongmenabenmo yareboon.
Kwane, Yesu kuu nimakarub yemoon menebiiwe wedmendekore, mimyob keendoon, amborom kuu aromkonoyiibbaniib dabawiib doriib, sibi areb yi ooni karuwiibban, dowan.
Kwane, Yesu ye kedmengkandeendan yaa daandoon, “Nimakarub kee, mongkobon animan yumune bi yeman karakiib areb, kumban yarebe bidan kuu yemoonban.
Kwanekob, yiib kuu yongbon benmo yarebi yeman ye Yariman kaamonenibko, yembed ye deme karub yaa yedmaneenkob mongkobon yumunoon angka bok wananiib.” andoon.

footnotes.text: Tak od bidan kembed tak od bi ye amob burudande od yena ari bimaib.
